question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.packaging_id AS root_id,
    pr.contains_id AS current_id,
    pr.qty AS level_qty,
    1 AS depth,
    ',' || CAST(pr.contains_id AS VARCHAR) || ',' AS path
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    pt.root_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    pt.level_qty * pr.qty,
    pt.depth + 1,
    pt.path || CAST(pr.contains_id AS VARCHAR) || ','
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
  WHERE pt.path NOT LIKE '%,' || CAST(pr.contains_id AS VARCHAR) || ',%'
),
leaf_ids AS (
  SELECT id FROM packaging
  WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
top_level_ids AS (
  SELECT id FROM packaging
  WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
leaf_totals AS (
  SELECT root_id, SUM(level_qty) AS total_qty
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN leaf_ids li ON pt.current_id = li.id
  GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM leaf_totals lt
JOIN top_level_ids tli ON lt.root_id = tli.id

args.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.packaging_id AS root_id,
    pr.contains_id AS current_id,
    pr.qty AS level_qty,
    1 AS depth,
    ',' || CAST(pr.contains_id AS VARCHAR) || ',' AS path
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    pt.root_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    pt.level_qty * pr.qty,
    pt.depth + 1,
    pt.path || CAST(pr.contains_id AS VARCHAR) || ','
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
  WHERE pt.path NOT LIKE '%,' || CAST(pr.contains_id AS VARCHAR) || ',%'
),
leaf_ids AS (
  SELECT id FROM packaging
  WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
leaf_totals AS (
  SELECT root_id, SUM(level_qty) AS total_qty
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN leaf_ids li ON pt.current_id = li.id
  GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT lt.root_id, p.name, lt.total_qty
FROM leaf_totals lt
JOIN packaging p ON p.id = lt.root_id
ORDER BY lt.root_id
